title: COGNITION-OF-THOUGHT ELICITS SOCIAL-ALIGNED REASONING IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework for 'social-aligned reasoning' that incorporates moral psychology and a precedence hierarchy of ethical principles (Safety > Altruism > Egoism). It evaluates LLMs on their 'ethical competence' using benchmarks like SocialEval and HarmBench, and provides extensive qualitative case studies on ethical dilemmas involving academic integrity, workplace harassment, and wartime moral choices.
